blocks.p: Eye of the North teaches 50 PvE-only skills, a dozen or so for each of its four peoples, every one the reward of a side quest. This guide assumes the storyline is done: the hubs are open and every chain can start. What is left is the quests below, by people, with the giver, where to find them, and the order a chain forces.
The skills are learned by the character and get stronger with the matching title, so take them as early as you like. Most quests are short errands from the outposts; the long ones are said so.

Twelve skills, in four trips: the Fighting Tournament in {area:644}, Sif's three hunts from {area:643}, Hogni's three blessings from his home in {area:513}, and the Olafsons' three from {area:645} and {area:553}.

steps.t: Talk to Gunnar Poundfist by the gate and take Truthseeker: it sends you to Hogni, for later.

Talk to Gellir Frostshield and pay the 100 gold entry fee, then to Magni the Bison, who starts the Norn Fighting Tournament: six solo rounds in the arena, each a quest from Magni, one after the other.
Win rounds 1 to 5. Your heroes stay outside; the fights are one on one, a Norn champion each time.
Beat Magni himself in the final. The first win gives {skill:2354}, {skill:2353} and {skill:2357} at once; later wins give a Championship Token instead.
Talk to Sif Shadowhunter and take Worthy Deeds (Done Dirt Cheap): three bosses in {area:513}, Koren Wildrunner, Myish, Lady of the Lake, and Nulfastu, Earthbound. Hand it in for {skill:2358}.
Sif's next, Anything You Can Do: Whiteout and Avarr the Fallen in {area:546}, then the Fragment of Antiquities at the end of the {area:628}, whose entrance is in Jaga Moraine.
Sif's last, Cold as Ice: tell her when you're ready and kill the Glacial Griffon she sets on you, for {skill:2356}.
Walk out into {area:553} and north into {area:513}: Hogni Truthseeker's home is in its south-west corner. Talking to him hands in Truthseeker, for {skill:2355}.
Take Hogni's three blessing quests in one go: A Hunter's Pride, Leader of the Pack and Shadows in the Night.
A Hunter's Pride: find the polar bear in {area:546}, take the honey from the branch, then lead the bear at the five young hunters until they run.
Leader of the Pack: in {area:482} enlist the six tundra wolves, then follow them south to the Destroyers and kill the lot.
Shadows in the Night: into {area:617}, the dungeon off {area:546}, and kill the shadow spawn.
Back to Hogni with all three: {skill:2374}, {skill:2379} and {skill:2384}, the three elite blessings.

The Olafsons' chain goes by your character's sex: a woman talks to Olaf Olafson in {area:645}, a man to Olrun Olafdottir out in {area:553}. Take The Great Norn Alemoot: drink, haul three kegs, drink, run the slalom, drink, herd three pigs. Hand in for {skill:2360}.
Bear Club for Women or Bear Club for Men: talk about the bear, take the club you're handed and beat the bear with it. Hand in for {skill:2361}.
Prenuptial Disagreement: find the bottomless pit in the north-east of {area:546} and kill Ssissth the leviathan. Hand in for {skill:2359}.

blocks.p: Fourteen skills: Kilroy's brawling in {area:644}, Undrath's two hunts from {area:643}, a treasure map in {area:639}, and the Deldrimor camp in the {area:625}, below the {area:652}.

steps.t: Talk to Kilroy Stonekin and take Punch the Clown: your bar is swapped for brawling skills and you beat a few Norn brawlers. Hand in for {skill:2215}.
Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!: go down with Kilroy into {area:704} and punch your way to Fronis Irontoe. Solo, brass knuckles only.
The Throwdown in a Norn Town: beat Bjorn Thunderfist in the championship brawl. Hand in for {skill:2213} and {skill:2214}.
Talk to Undrath Blastrock and take both: Krak's Cavalry and The Big Unfriendly Jotun.
Krak's Cavalry: find and kill Krak Flamewhip's cavalry patrol in {area:546}.
The Big Unfriendly Jotun: kill Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash in {area:513}, in the east.
Back to Undrath with both: {skill:2216} for the cavalry, {skill:2222} and {skill:2423} for the jotun.
Talk to Koris Deeprunner and take Deeprunner's Map: four map pieces, each at the end of a run through the Depths from one of the Asura gates. Hand in for {skill:2218}.

Walk into the {area:625}: the Deldrimor camp is by the way in. Talk to Orozar Highstone and take Attack on Jalis's Camp; ask him when Ural will arrive, then hold the camp against the Stone Summit waves. Hand in for {skill:2217} and {skill:2219}.
Orozar's next, In the Service of Revenge: a hidden Stone Summit camp in the west of {area:513}, every dwarf in it. Hand in for {skill:2220} and {skill:2223}.

Talk to High Priest Alkar in the same camp (he also stands in the {area:652}) and take Destructive Research: three Destroyer Cores, dropped by Destroyers anywhere. Hand in for {skill:2221} and {skill:2212}.
Alkar's next, The Destroyer Challenge: use his concoction on Destroyers. Hand in for {skill:2211}.

blocks.p: Twelve skills: four from Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}, eight from the Vanguard in the Charr homelands, where the givers only talk once you have listened to them: Vael in the middle of {area:649}, Captain Langmar by the {area:650} portal, Sergeant Weststar with his troops outside it.

steps.t: Talk to Artificer Mullenix and take Charr Invaders and Mano a Norn-o.
Charr Invaders: wipe out the Charr expedition in {area:548}, out of the Eye's back door. Hand in for {skill:2422}.
Mano a Norn-o: tell Mullenix you're ready and duel Knorr Oaken. Hand in for {skill:2228}.
Service: Practice, Dummy: lead the Eye's staff out and smash 20 practice dummies in three minutes. Hand in for {skill:2235}.
Service: In Defense of the Eye: defend the Eye against the centaurs with the same staff. Hand in for {skill:2420}.
Walk out into {area:649} and find Vael in the middle of the area: listen to his dialogue. Then re-zone (map back to {area:650} and walk out again): only now does he offer Be Very, Very Quiet....

Be Very, Very Quiet...: shadow Torch Harrowkeeper without being seen, eavesdrop, talk to Vael, crash the Charr and Grawl meeting, and bring the intelligence to Captain Langmar, just outside the Longeye's Ledge portal, for {skill:2231}.
Re-zone once more, then Langmar offers Plan A: meet Vael at the rendezvous, wait for his diversion, run into the camp and steal the plans, back to Langmar for {skill:2116}.

Langmar's next, Forbidden Fruit: meet Vael in {area:651} (from {area:648}), follow him to the hierophant's stronghold, three minutes to poison the food and get out, kill Gharaz the Glutton when it goes wrong, report to Vael for {skill:2230}.

Vael, still in {area:651}, then offers Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon: wait for his diversion, rush in and kill Vyrrgis the Pestilent. Hand in at Langmar for {skill:2421}.
Langmar's last, The Smell of Titan in the Morning: flush out and slay the Titan in {area:651}. Hand in for {skill:2233}.
Before leaving {area:649}: stand by Sergeant Weststar and his troops outside the Longeye's Ledge portal and hear him out. Without this, the corpse in Dalada never speaks.

spots.name: The Charr camp with the plans

steps.t: Walk out into {area:647} to the Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon and take Falling Out: find out what became of Jenn Valefield, Chance Redding and Sergeant Weststar, which ends at Weststar in {area:651}, for {skill:2234}.
Weststar, there at the mouth of {area:573}, offers The Hunting of the Charr: into the dungeon after Rake Blazeclaw, then the Enforcer. Hand in at Langmar for {skill:2229}.
Weststar, back outside {area:648}, offers Forgotten Relics: the captives' cave in {area:647}, the Charr guards, the Flaming Scepter Mages. Hand in for {skill:2232}.

blocks.p: Twelve skills: one from Blorf in {area:624}, seven from Kerrsh's Ciphers in {area:641}, and the four summons from Polymock, the Asuran board game, run by Hoff in {area:640}.

steps.t: Talk to Blorf and take O Brave New World: meet Erff in {area:485}, walk him to two settlement sites, and hold off the Destroyers from his work krewe. Hand in for {skill:2411}.
Talk to Kerrsh and take The Cipher of Melandru: his Divination points you to the Facet of Creation; kill it for its cipher. Hand in for {skill:2412}.

The next four Ciphers open at once; take them all: Balthazar (Facet of Destruction), Dwayna (Existence), Grenth (Death), Lyssa (Illusions). The Divination leads to each. Hand in for {skill:2417}, {skill:2414}, {skill:2415} and {skill:2413}.
The Cipher of Kormir: the Facet of Spirit. Hand in for {skill:2418}.
The Path to Revelations: all six Facets again, in a crater in eastern {area:553}, out of {area:645}. Hand in for {skill:2416}.
Talk to Hoff: he hands out three starter Polymock pieces. Register them with Denn beside him before anything else; a registered piece is the character's for good.
Four matches to learn the game, each a quest from Hoff and each winning a piece: Yulma here in {area:640}, Plurgg in {area:624}, Blarp in {area:638}, Fonk in {area:644}.
Then the three that teach, in any order: Grulhammer Silverfist in {area:639} for {skill:2225}, Necromancer Volumandus in {area:641} for {skill:2226}, Dune Teardrinker in {area:648} for {skill:2227}.
Last, Master Hoff himself, back in {area:640}, for {skill:2224}.
